ideas.pitch: A multilingual offline-first voice agent providing preventive care guidance and outbreak tracking tailored for rural communities.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1 / General Problem: Public health awareness and rural healthcare accessibility.
ideas.title: ArogyaSetu Rural Health AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on the winning architecture of SAGACITY by addressing regional health literacy with localized speech models, a priority for impact-focused judges.

ideas.pitch: An IoT and machine learning web platform predicting urban waterlogging and contamination risks days in advance.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1 / General Problem: Smart city infrastructure and disaster prevention.
ideas.title: EcoDrain Smart Urban Water Management
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines predictive environmental analytics with a clear municipal use-case, mirroring the award-winning structure of iForeSea.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent workflow orchestrator for local municipal bodies to triage citizen grievances and auto-assign task tickets.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1 / General Problem: Efficient governance and civic grievance redressal.
ideas.title: CivicFlow Agentic Chief of Staff
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages agentic frameworks and autonomous data routing similar to the winning Civic Challenge and DataHub Agent Hackathon projects.

ideas.pitch: A statistical forecasting dashboard predicting systemic institutional failures using Poisson regression and calibrated confidence bounds.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1 / General Problem: Risk management and predictive data analytics for public systems.
ideas.title: VeriForesee AI Incident Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs rigorous statistical validation and rolling backtests that impress technical judges looking for genuine algorithmic complexity.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision garbage classification backend paired with a microcontroller simulation pipeline for automated municipal waste segregation.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1 / General Problem: Sustainable waste management and recycling automation.
ideas.title: GreenBin AI Garbage Sorting Robot Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Integrates hardware prototyping workflows with real-time computer vision, replicating the runner-up success seen at TechnoMorph.
